claims.statement: Inbox filter reference declares FPT/GHEC/GHES but author/org and discussion/advisory types are FPT/GHEC conditional. Notification grammar requires surface/platform adapter, not general issue/Projects search reuse.

Custom filters lack full-text/title search, NOT/minus exclusions, default-filter editing/reordering and allow at most15 custom filters. Unsupported operations must remain explicit, not silently broadened or ignored.
is:issue/is:pr/is:pull-request all return issues and PRs; cannot distinguish these item types via these queries. Missing distinction must not produce false separate coverage counts.
repo requires exact owner/repository identity. org is organization of notifying repository; author is original thread author, not latest actor or notification sender.

Supported activity types include check-suite,commit,gist,issue-or-pull-request,release,repository-invitation,vulnerability-alert; cloud advisory/discussion conditionals apply. Type hits are notifications, not exhaustive entities.
is:saved/done/unread/read encode inbox triage, not underlying work acceptance, resolved vulnerability or completed review.

Reasons distinguish assignment,authorship,comment/participation,invitation,manual subscription,direct/team mentions,requested review,security,state-change and CI activity. Event reason does not certify current underlying state or performed response.

Main lists use repository-vulnerability-alert/security-alert while Dependabot examples use repository_vulnerability_alert/security_alert. Hyphen/underscore syntax conflict remains unresolved; adapter behavior must be independently tested before adopting security coverage.
Dependabot author example app/dependabot spans alerts/security/version PRs and is cloud-author qualifier context; bot origin is not guaranteed trust, correct remediation or safe automatic approval.

Related setup/notification/dependency docs remain separate source review work. No inbox filters or notification state changed; source reference accounting does not certify full notification delivery or published content.
